title_i18n.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的有状态接续：传输层为何至关重要
title_i18n.en: Stateful Continuation for AI Agents: Why the Transport Layer Is Crucial
title_i18n.es: La continuidad con estado para agentes de IA: por qué es crucial la capa de transporte

excerpt_i18n.zh: 智能体工作流对传输效率要求极高，多轮重度工具调用会显著增加传输开销，通过有状态接续和服务端上下文缓存可大幅减少传输数据并提升执行速度。
excerpt_i18n.en: The workflow of intelligent agents requires extremely high transmission efficiency. Multiple rounds of heavy tool calls can significantly increase transmission overhead. Stateful continuation and server-side context caching can greatly reduce the amount of transmitted data and improve execution speed.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los flujos de trabajo de agentes inteligentes requieren una alta eficiencia en la transmisión. Las múltiples llamadas a herramientas intensivas aumentan significativamente los costos de transmisión. La continuidad con estado y el almacenamiento en caché del contexto en el servidor pueden reducir considerablemente los datos transmitidos y mejorar la velocidad de ejecución.

Behind the name change: Transition from "car manufacturing" to a "physical AI technology group"

In the past decade, XPeng's focus was on intelligent EVs; for the next decade, the focus will be on physical AI, which involves using large models as a foundation to enable perception, understanding, decision-making, and execution in the physical world through vehicles, robots, flying cars, and other physical carriers.

This judgment is supported by his understanding of the technological pace.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Yang Yiting Editor: Bao Yonggang

At last year's CFMS | MemoryS Summit, storage manufacturers discussed when prices would stabilize, when QLC would scale up, and when AI PCs would be realized. At that time, the idea that "AI will make storage more fundamental and critical" was more of an industry prediction, a preview of future trends.

A year later, at the MemoryS 2026 conference, the questions have completely changed. Discussions no longer focus solely on bit costs, chip supply, and capacity schedules, but also on GPU utilization, token costs, system scheduling efficiency, and even real-time decision-making capabilities in physical AI scenarios. Issues originally belonging to AI infrastructure and system architecture are increasingly appearing at the center of storage industry discussions.

In traditional computing architectures, the role of storage has primarily been to "store." Data is written, retained, and retrieved when needed, otherwise remaining idle at the periphery of the system. It has long been an item in the BOM cost, a matter of capacity planning, and rarely directly involved in defining computational efficiency.

However, in the era of large model training and inference, this role has been completely rewritten. The access latency of KV Cache now directly affects token generation rates; the write efficiency of Checkpoints determines the waiting time of GPUs during training; and the IOPS density of SSDs further influences concurrency and system throughput in large model inference scenarios. Storage is now entering the main path of computation, determining the speed of data flow.

Entonces, la idea de que "la IA haría que el almacenamiento sea más básico y crucial" parecía más una evaluación del sector, una previsión futura. Un año después, en el MemoryS 2026, las preguntas han cambiado por completo. Ya no se habla solo de costos de bits, suministro de chips y ritmo de capacidad, sino de la utilización de GPUs, costos de tokens, eficiencia de programación del sistema e incluso la capacidad de toma de decisiones en tiempo real en escenarios físicos de IA. excerpt_i18n.en: No one misses Xiaoice more than Li Di. "Our current company is called Tomorrow's New Journey because I can't call it Xiaoice; if I could, I would." As the founder of the new company, Li Di still speaks with evident fondness when mentioning the AI product he built from scratch. Known as the "father of Xiaoice," this identity has been Li Di's most prominent label, and it's a product to which he devoted over a decade. However, everything took a sharp turn after the Spring Festival of 2025—first, he was relieved of his duties in February, and then in late November, the core product X Eva was officially discontinued, forcing Xiaoice into a dormant phase. This was not a graceful exit. Li Di, along with a core team, pivoted to the intelligent entity track in December 2025, making their debut at Ji Qi's Jiqi Creation Forum under the name "Tomorrow's New Journey." The team remains small, with fewer than twenty members. We met Li Di twice in Wudaokou, once at the end of 2025 and again at the beginning of 2026. Reflecting on the past, Li Di tries to view and let go of it as an observer, but he still self-deprecates and harbors some regret—"The only thing I truly regret is not developing a reasoning model at the end of 2023." In his recollection, each technical decision corresponds to a window of opportunity: "I may have just lost a name, but Xiaoice lost a year and a half to two years." From this perspective, Xiaoice's growth trajectory, as well as the divergences and choices at critical junctures, take on another layer of interpretation. excerpt_i18n.es: Nadie piensa más en Xiaoice que Li Di. "Ahora nuestra empresa se llama Mingri Xin Cheng, porque no puedo llamarla Xiaoice, si pudiera, la llamaría Xiaoice". Li Di, ya fundador de la nueva empresa, habla de este producto AI que creó con un claro tono de preferencia. "El padre de Xiaoice" es la etiqueta más conocida de Li Di y el producto AI al que dedicó más de diez años, pero todo cambió drásticamente después del Año Nuevo Chino de 2025: primero fue destituido en febrero, y luego en noviembre su producto central X Eva cesó sus servicios, forzando a Xiaoice a entrar en un período de letargo. No fue una despedida digna, Li Di se llevó consigo un equipo central.

items.raw_excerpt: 近日，豆包APP实时语音通话功能升级，上线全双工语音大模型Seeduplex 。据介绍，作为原生全双工端到端语音大模型，Seeduplex 能够在复杂声学场景下实现精准抗干扰与动态判停，提供更顺畅、更自然的语音交互体验。 此次更新后，豆包实时语音通话功能在对话自然度、响应速度和抗干扰能力等方面均有提升。 记者实测发现，升级后的豆包语音通话在复杂环境下表现出较强的抗干扰能力，即便周围存在人声和噪音干扰，也能较准确地识别用户语音，不易被无关声音带偏。以餐厅、展览等易出现多人交谈的场景为例，过往 AI 产品容易因背景噪音或旁人说话声出现误打断、误回复等情况；此次升级后，豆包对无关声音的过滤能力有所增强，对话过程也更不容易被人声意外打断。 除抗干扰能力外，升级后的语音对话节奏也更接近自然交流。人与人对话中，停顿并不总意味着发言结束。此次升级后，豆包可结合语音与语义信息判断用户是否仍在继续表达，从而减少对话中的“抢话”现象。与此同时，对话响应时延也进一步降低，在接龙、飞花令等高频互动场景中表现更为明显。 目前，这一能力已在豆包 APP上线。用户可点击“打电话”按钮，开启实时语音通话功能体验。 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the Doudou app has upgraded its real-time voice call feature with the launch of the full-duplex voice model Seeduplex. As a native full-duplex end-to-end voice model, Seeduplex can achieve precise interference resistance and dynamic pause detection in complex acoustic environments, providing a smoother and more natural voice interaction experience. After this update, the Doudou real-time voice call function has improved in conversation naturalness, response speed, and interference resistance. Journalists found that the upgraded Doudou voice calls demonstrate strong interference resistance in complex environments, accurately identifying user voices even with surrounding noise. In scenarios like restaurants or exhibitions where multiple conversations occur, past AI products often misinterpreted background noise or bystander speech, leading to interruptions or incorrect responses. With this upgrade, Doudou's ability to filter out irrelevant sounds has improved, making conversations less likely to be interrupted by external voices. Besides interference resistance, the upgraded voice dialogue now flows more naturally. In human conversations, pauses do not always indicate the end of a statement. The updated Doudou can now judge whether the user is still speaking by combining voice and semantic information, reducing instances of "talking over" in conversations. Additionally, the response latency has been further reduced, particularly noticeable in high-frequency interactive scenarios such as word games. This capability is now available on the Doudou app. Users can click the "Make a Call" button to start the real-time voice call feature.

Tras esta actualización, la función de llamadas de voz en tiempo real de Dòubāo ha mejorado en términos de naturalidad en la conversación, velocidad de respuesta y capacidad de supresión de interferencias. Los periodistas han constatado en pruebas reales que, tras la actualización, las llamadas de voz de Dòubāo muestran una mayor resistencia a las interferencias en entornos complejos, siendo capaces de reconocer con precisión la voz del usuario incluso en presencia de voces y ruidos ambientales, sin ser fácilmente afectadas por elementos irrelevantes.

On April 9, SynapX announced it had secured strategic investment from Singapore's K3, with existing shareholders Shunwei, Xiaomi, Hillhouse, and Linear continuing to invest. On its long-term journey toward Physical AGI (Physical World General Artificial Intelligence), SynapX adheres to first principles, viewing the home environment as its guiding star and the ultimate test for Physical AI. The company focuses on the most generalized, versatile, and unrestricted home scene to drive foundational capability development, product evolution, organizational growth, and commercialization pace. K3’s strategic entry brings not only top-tier international industrial capital but also a vast global resource network and real-world application systems, further expanding the company's industrial resource base for long-term development. SynapX continues to deepen its focus.
